scripts.deploy:infra: az deployment sub create --location westeurope --name homehost-deploy --template-file infra/main.bicep
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && cd frontend/dist && zip -r ../dist.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && cd .. && az webapp deploy --resource-group $(az deployment sub show --name homehost-deploy --query properties.outputs.resourceGroupName.value -o tsv) --name $(az deployment sub show --name homehost-deploy --query properties.outputs.appServiceName.value -o tsv) --src-path dist.zip --type zip
scripts.deploy:functions: rm -rf functions/node_modules && npm ci --prefix functions && cd functions && zip -r ../func-deploy.zip . -x 'local.settings.json' -x '*.git*' -x '.DS_Store' && cd .. && az functionapp deployment source config-zip --resource-group $(az deployment sub show --name homehost-deploy --query properties.outputs.resourceGroupName.value -o tsv) --name $(az deployment sub show --name homehost-deploy --query properties.outputs.functionAppName.value -o tsv) --src func-deploy.zip && rm -f func-deploy.zip
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:infra && npm run deploy:frontend
scripts.outputs: az deployment sub show --name homehost-deploy --query properties.outputs
